comments.author: GlassFullOfSlop
comments.body_html:
I’ve unpublished v1.0.1 - It got 4 false flags from VirusTotal from AVG, Avast and 2 others. Which is usually fine, however considering every subsequent time it gets scanned it is being flagged more. I’d like to assure everyone that as a precaution despite knowing there is nothing there I’ve scanned my entire PC and all files relating to the release. But for peace of mind unpublishing is easier.

v1.0.2 is now up and passes its VirusTotal with no false positives.

comments.author: GlassFullOfSlop
comments.body_html: Nothing but a simple version increment which in hindsight wasn’t needed since all I was changing was the bundles, but my brain wanted to keep version numbers in sync. As to why that flagged I can only assume they saw the original .dll appear then not long after it gets rescanned with a different hash and thought it was suspicious.
